name: Newfangled
description:
The daring and inventive spirit of End of Adventure has produced some newfangled contraptions.

When you gain this ability, choose one, which you own:

  • A pocketwatch that keeps accurate time if you spend one minute winding it each day.

  • A parachute, held in a backpack. While wearing it, you may spend an action to pull the ripcord. When you do, roll a d8. On a 1, the parachute fails to deploy and has no effect. Otherwise, the parachute slows you falling to a safe speed.

  • A camera with one roll of film (good for 5 exposures) and a developing kit. Whenever you spend an action to take a photograph, roll a d8. On a 1, the camera jams, the image is overexposed and you must spend 1 minute fixing it. Otherwise, the image is captured. The developing process requires darkness and one hour of work. You may purchase additional rolls of film in End of Adventure at a cost of 50 treasure per roll.

Describe your newfangled contraption.
